name: asmpat: a plate part (hole pattern, a point sketch, a path sketch) and a pin part, both placed in a new assembly
asmpat: pattern driven — a pin in every hole of the plate linear pattern
asmpat: the pattern record keeps its rigid moves (the copies follow the seed through them)
asmpat: sketch driven — a copy at each other point of the "Points" sketch
asmpat: curve driven — 5 copies equally along the "Path" line (100 long)
asmpat: chain — links every pitch 12.7 along the path
asmpat: undo takes the chain pattern back
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const a = m.active(); const n = a.patterns.length; await m.run('undo'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); return n + ' ' + m.active().patterns.length; })()
